currentPosition.title: Founder / AI Sales Transformation Consultant / Fractional AI Ops / GTM Engineer

person.summary:
For over two decades, I've been on the front lines of B2B sales, helping organizations build and scale high-performance GTM teams. I've navigated the complexities of enterprise sales from every angle, both as a hands-on leader and an individual contributor. Most recently, I served as the VP Sales at CaliberMind, where I led our team through a period of immense change and growth.

Now, after decades immersed in this world, I'm stepping back to pursue a personal project.

The B2B sales landscape has been fundamentally reshaped. The old playbooks are failing, and the pressure to do more with less has never been greater. Revenue leaders know that AI is not just a buzzword; it's a non-negotiable part of the future of their organizations. Yet, the path forward is anything but clear. The market is saturated with "AI features" that often feel more like gimmicks than game-changers, creating confusion and uncertainty.

I'm excited to share more in the coming weeks. For now, let's connect and explore what's next.
